items.name: status-colors
items.title: Status colors
items.description: The success and warning color tokens used by WorkspaceUI components (text-success, bg-warning/10, ...). Adds the CSS variables and Tailwind theme mappings for them.

items.name: workspace
items.title: Workspace
items.description: Self-contained workspace with tab-based panels: closing a panel's last tab collapses the panel; closing all panels reveals a configurable fallback. Exposes useWorkspace context and a WorkspaceHandle ref for programmatic control. Bundles its internal tab strip and drag context.

items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: Page shell with an optional header (title/subtitle, breadcrumbs, visual, badge, actions) and a content area that can be padded.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with a show/hide visibility toggle and an optional live strength meter. Exports a scorePassword heuristic. Wraps InputGroup; works controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: Generic status-to-Badge-variant mapper — pass a variantMap (and optional labelMap) for your status union instead of hand-rolling a `<Status>_VARIANT` map and Badge render per table/detail view.

items.name: board-card
items.title: Board Card
items.description: Draggable, sortable card shell for kanban-style boards — wraps your own card content in @dnd-kit's useSortable, with pointer and keyboard drag support and in-column reordering.

items.name: board-column
items.title: Board Column
items.description: Kanban board column — @dnd-kit droppable shell with a label/count header, item list, and empty state. Renders arbitrary items via renderItem (typically a BoardCard); drop handling lives in the DndContext.onDragEnd that wraps the board. Optionally sortable for column reordering via a header grip handle.

items.name: data-grid-types
items.title: Data Grid Types
items.description: column.meta type contract shared by data-grid and data-filter — the eight-type column union plus per-type meta fields, declared via TanStack's own module augmentation.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: Editable grid over a consumer-owned useReactTable() instance. Every cell renders its live control, borderless and transparent at rest; click or type to edit, blur or Enter to commit. Async commits show a pending spinner, disable the control, and surface rejection errors inline without reverting the typed value. Full spreadsheet keyboard model over role="grid" with roving tabindex. All eight column types (text, number, currency, select, boolean, date, multiSelect, user) have working editors; multiSelect and user share a popover widget — a borderless trigger (chips capped at meta.maxChips, or an avatar plus name) opening a searchable command list. Optional onRowAdd/onRowDelete render inline row-add (trailing "+ New row" and a between-row hover "+") and a hover kebab delete with confirmation. Every column resizes via a border-drag handle (double-click resets), pins left/right via a hover-fade header icon that sticks on horizontal scroll, and reorders through a toolbar "Columns" panel built on @dnd-kit/sortable (pointer or keyboard drag, across the shown/hidden groups); optional onColumnLayoutChange reports the resulting order/sizing/pinning. Below a 448px measured container width (never the viewport), narrowFallback="cards" (default) swaps the grid for a card list with a bottom-up swipeable drawer editor sharing the same commit/pending/error behavior; narrowFallback="none" keeps the grid with a sticky first column instead.

items.name: data-filter
items.title: Data Filter
items.description: A composable filter builder over a consumer-owned useReactTable() instance. A single "+ Filter" trigger opens a popover chaining column → operator → value; committing writes a clickable, removable chip. Operators and the value input follow from the column's meta.type — text, number, currency, date, select, and boolean are implemented here (multiSelect and user are a follow-up). Exports dataGridFilterFn, the filterFn every filterable column must set: it unwraps the chip chain's { operator, value } object and dispatches on meta.type, since none of TanStack's built-in filter functions can read that shape. Measures its own container width via ResizeObserver; below 448px the chip chain and popover give way to swipeable bottom-drawer "Sort" and "Filter" toolbar buttons.

items.name: data-search
items.title: Data Search
items.description: A debounced global-search input over a consumer-owned useReactTable() instance. Exports dataGridGlobalFilterFn, the globalFilterFn every table needs set: it matches primitive cell values (string/number/boolean) case-insensitively and skips columns with no accessor value (id/select/action columns) and array/object values (multiSelect tags, user objects).

items.name: data-pagination
items.title: Data Pagination
items.description: A pagination footer over a consumer-owned useReactTable() instance: filtered selection count, a rows-per-page select, a "Page X of Y" indicator, and first/previous/next/last controls disabled at the boundaries. Drives TanStack's own pagination state and requires getPaginationRowModel(); DataGrid renders it automatically when the table it's given has one.

items.name: bulk-toolbar
items.title: Bulk Toolbar
items.description: Contextual toolbar shown while rows are selected — a count, a clear control, and consumer-supplied action buttons as children. Renders nothing when count is 0.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage Meter
items.description: Plan-quota meter: used vs. limit with ok, warning, exceeded, and unlimited states spelled out in text as well as color. Exports getUsageStatus for gating features on the same thresholds.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: Dashboard KPI tile: headline figure, period-over-period delta (with invertDelta for down-is-good metrics), optional sparkline, and a layout-matched loading skeleton.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: Get-started card: progress bar, app-owned step completion, the next incomplete step expanded with its call to action, a completion message, and an optional dismiss.

items.name: secret-field
items.title: Secret Field
items.description: Read-only field for API keys and tokens: masks the value (keeping its sk_live_-style prefix and last characters), with a reveal toggle and a copy button that always copies the full secret. Exports maskSecret.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping member avatars with a +N overflow count, initials fallback, and name tooltips on hover and keyboard focus. The group is labelled with a name summary for screen readers.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Sidebar Shell (Icon-collapsible)
items.description: Icon-collapsible sidebar (trigger lives in the sidebar) paired with the Workspace component; each tab renders inside the Page component.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Sidebar Shell (Collapsible)
items.description: Collapsible sidebar nav that swaps a single content area directly, no tabs.

items.name: dashboard-02
items.title: Icon Rail Shell (Top Bar)
items.description: App icon + org switcher and search in a full-width top bar, paired with a fixed icon-only nav rail (settings and profile pinned to the bottom).

items.name: dashboard-rail
items.title: Rail + Sidebar Shell
items.description: Dual-sidebar shell: a fixed icon-only app rail (logo, app switcher, settings, profile) beside a collapsible nav sidebar, paired with the Workspace component.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.title: Full Sidebar Shell (Multi-tab)
items.description: Rich collapsible sidebar (quick-create action, grouped Documents section, secondary nav, and a user menu) paired with a multi-tab Workspace whose first tab is an empty Home landing state.

items.name: access-control
items.title: Access Control
items.description: Roles and permissions: new roles start from an existing role, a view-dependent permission matrix with row and column bulk toggles, staged Save/Discard, and a locked Owner role that can be duplicated.

items.name: settings
items.title: Sectioned Settings Page
items.description: Sectioned workspace settings — company profile, notifications, billing, and security.

items.name: credit-usage
items.title: Credit Usage
items.description: Credit usage page for API and AI products: plan allowance as a stacked by-category bar with tooltips and legend, headline stats, a Day/Week/Month period switch, and searchable, filterable Agents and Power users tables with CSV export.

items.name: login
items.title: Login
items.description: Email and password sign-in form — inline field validation, invalid-credentials banner, pending state, remember-me, and forgot-password/sign-up links.

items.name: register
items.title: Register
items.description: Account sign-up form with a live password-strength meter, field validation, terms agreement, and a verify-your-email confirmation state.

items.name: otp-verify
items.title: OTP Verify
items.description: One-time passcode entry with a 6-digit segmented input, auto-verify on complete, incorrect-code error, and a countdown-gated resend.

items.name: forgot-password
items.title: Forgot Password
items.description: Request a password-reset link by email — field validation, pending state, and a neutral check-your-email confirmation that doesn't leak account existence.

items.name: reset-password
items.title: Reset Password
items.description: Set-a-new-password form with a live strength meter, confirm-match validation, an expired-link state, and a password-updated confirmation.

items.name: change-password
items.title: Change Password
items.description: Authenticated in-app password change — current-password re-auth check, new-password strength meter, confirm-match validation, and a changed confirmation.

items.name: two-factor-challenge
items.title: Two-Factor Challenge
items.description: Post-password 2FA step — authenticator-app code entry with auto-verify, a recovery-code fallback, trust-this-device option, and error states.

items.name: two-factor-setup
items.title: Two-Factor Setup
items.description: Authenticator enrollment — QR code, copyable manual setup key, and a 6-digit verify step with error and enabled states.

items.name: recovery-codes
items.title: Recovery Codes
items.description: Backup-code display with copy, download, and regenerate actions, gated behind an "I've saved them" acknowledgement before continuing.

items.name: magic-link-sent
items.title: Magic Link Sent
items.description: Passwordless check-your-email confirmation after requesting a magic sign-in link — expiry note, cooldown-gated resend, and change-email action.

items.name: verify-email
items.title: Verify Email
items.description: Post-registration confirm-your-email pending screen — cooldown-gated resend and a transition to the email-confirmed success state.

items.name: login-social
items.title: Login (Social)
items.description: Sign-in with Google/GitHub SSO buttons over an email-and-password form — provider divider, inline validation, invalid-credentials banner, and pending state.

items.name: session-expired
items.title: Session Expired
items.description: Re-authentication prompt after an idle timeout — quick password re-entry for the current user, incorrect-password error, and a switch-user action.

items.name: account-locked
items.title: Account Locked
items.description: Account-locked screen after too many failed sign-in attempts — shows the locked email, a lockout countdown, and reset/support actions.

items.name: pending-approval
items.title: Pending Approval
items.description: Account-under-review status screen — explains the pending admin approval, the notification email, and check-status/sign-out actions.

items.name: forbidden-workspace
items.title: Forbidden Workspace
items.description: Wrong-tenant screen — signed in but not a member of this workspace, with a switcher to workspaces you belong to and a switch-account action.

items.name: account-suspended
items.title: Account Suspended
items.description: Suspended-account screen — shows the suspension reason and offers an appeal action with a submitted confirmation plus a contact-support link.

items.name: unauthorized-403
items.title: Unauthorized 403
items.description: Signed-in-but-forbidden screen — explains the missing permission, offers a request-access action with a sent confirmation, and a back link.

items.name: upgrade-required
items.title: Upgrade Required
items.description: Plan-gated feature screen — a signed-in user hits a Pro-only feature, with the perks it unlocks, an upgrade action, and an ask-an-admin fallback that confirms once sent.
